title: GraphitiEpisodeSourceV2
description: iris_memory#14: focused semantic metadata aligned with Roadmap v27. Adds semanticKind, attributionClass, sourceTrust and referenceTime as first-class episode-source metadata. V1 artifacts remain immutable; this version coexists with backward-compatible negotiation.

episodeSourceHash.description: Deterministic canonical hash of THIS episode source (identity + provenance + content + metadata). Re-hashed by the Memory on acceptance.

episodeId.description: Memory-owned deterministic episode identity (stable across replay).

canonicalContent.description: Focused episode body — NOT a whole-batch concatenation.

isDerivedOnly.description: True when the episode contains NO new observation truth.

semanticKind.description: iris_memory#14: the semantic category of this episode source. Enables focused Graphiti Episode ingestion instead of whole-batch concatenation.

attributionClass.description: iris_memory#14: the primary attribution class of the episode content.

sourceTrust.description: iris_memory#14: trust level of the source material.

referenceTime.description: iris_memory#14: the canonical reference time for this episode (distinct from temporal window — used for temporal validity in Graphiti).
